findings.claim: FY2025 10-K Item 3 列示的訴訟為 Gumm v. Molinaroli（2016 年 Tyco 合併股東集體訴訟），2025-03-28 遭法院全案駁回，原告已上訴；Item 3 未列反壟斷調查。
findings.source: SEC EDGAR 10-K FY2025 Item 3 Legal Proceedings
findings.excerpt: On March 28, 2025, the Court dismissed the complaint in its entirety. Plaintiffs have appealed the decision, though the timing of the decision by the court is currently unknown.

findings.claim: 10-K 風險因素提到跨國營運受反壟斷、出口管制、關稅等複雜法規約束，並稱無法保證持續被認定合規。
findings.source: SEC EDGAR 10-K FY2025 Item 1A Risk Factors
findings.excerpt: No assurances can be made that we will continue to be found to be operating in compliance with, or be able to detect violations of, any such laws or regulations.

findings.claim: 香港競爭事務委員會對 Johnson Controls Hong Kong、其母公司及一名前員工提起第二宗競爭審裁處程序，指控 2015-12 至 2018-06 空調工程定價、分割市場及圍標，違反第一行為守則，涉案工程逾 HK$3 billion。
findings.source: The Standard (HK) - Poon company in hot water again over alleged cartel
findings.excerpt: The Competition Commission has commenced another set of proceedings against a company owned by Otto Poon Lok-to, husband of former secretary for justice Teresa Cheng Yeuk-wah, for alleged price-fixing, market-sharing and bid-rigging.

note: 搜尋摘要顯示香港競爭事務委員會 2026-04 前後對 Johnson Controls Hong Kong 及母公司提起第二宗競爭審裁處程序（2015-12～2018-06 空調工程圍標/分割市場/定價，涉案逾 HK$3 billion），僅有搜尋摘要未讀頁面，列為 clue。未見 2026 美國 DOJ/FTC 或歐盟對 JCI 的反壟斷調查。 線索 1 條，程式核實 1 條
